name: – Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares – § 45 – Am 25
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 45. Highlights that the green and digital transition is inextricably linked to Europe’s long-term prosperity, well-being, sustainability, growth and competitiveness; underlines that the ultimate success of the twin transition will depend heavily on ensuring that transition is just and inclusive for workers, regions and businesses, and that it contributes to social justice for all, with particular focus on the most vulnerable, in order to ensure that no one is left behind; insists therefore, that the 2028-2034 MFF must continue to support the twin transition; regrets that the proposal for the 2028-2034 MFF does not include a stand-alone instrument, thereby disregarding Parliament’s position in favour of a Just Transition Fund II as expressed in its recent own-initiative resolution; calls for the next MFF to restore this ambition and ensure that relevant funds support a just transition through dedicated and territorially focused mechanisms; and calls for relevant funds under the next MFF to nevertheless support a just transition; highlights in addition the need for synergies and complementarity among cohesion policy funds and the Competitiveness Fund; highlights, in particular, the fact that the green and digital transition is generating new and evolving occupational risks; calls, therefore, for relevant funds under the next MFF to support the prevention of work-related accidents and diseases, the adaptation of workplaces, the protection of workers from hazardous substances, extreme temperatures and psychosocial risks, as well as training and reskilling measures that integrate occupational safety and health from the outset;
